title: Chili Pan Mee with Mushrooms & Eggplant
style: Malaysian-style chewy noodles tossed with spicy sambal, umami mushroom-eggplant mince, and greens
description: Chewy flat noodles tossed with a spicy homemade sambal paste, topped with umami-rich mushroom and eggplant mince, fresh greens, and a hint of toasted sesame.

items.note: mixed with 1 tbsp water for slurry

items.item: drizzle of sesame oil or chili oil

steps: Prepare Sambal Paste: Soak dried red chilies in boiling water 1–2 min. Blend with shallots, garlic, fresh chili, and a splash of water to a smooth paste.
Heat oil in a pan over medium. Fry the chili paste 2–3 min until fragrant and slightly darker. Add coconut sugar, fry 1 min, then set aside.
Cook Noodles: Boil ban mian noodles according to package instructions. Drain, reserving some noodle water for later.
Prepare Mushroom-Eggplant Mince: Mince mushrooms and eggplant finely. Heat sesame oil and garlic in a pan, sauté 30 sec.
Add eggplant and mushrooms, sauté until half-cooked. Add light & dark soy sauce, vegan oyster sauce, sweetener, and a splash of noodle water. Continue cooking.
Add white pepper and cornstarch slurry. Simmer 2–3 min with lid closed until thickened.
Assemble Bowls: Divide noodles into bowls. Toss with 1/2 tbsp dark soy sauce and 1 tsp sesame oil per serving.
Top with blanched greens, mushroom-eggplant mince, and sambal paste. Mix thoroughly before eating.
Optional Finish: Add toasted nuts, fresh herbs, extra chili flakes, or drizzle of sesame/chili oil for more texture and aroma.
tips: Blanch greens quickly to retain crunch and bright color.
Reserve some noodle water to adjust sauce consistency.
Finely mincing eggplant and mushrooms helps them cling to the noodles for maximum flavor.
Sambal can be made in advance and stored in the fridge for up to a week.
